normal.text: Right? Like, this seems like a remarkably well-made life sim, which happens to be centered on a life of crime It seems like it understands its central relationship better than most games, I may actually buy it, I had no plans to do so even a week ago

normal.name: Ray the Mimikyu (12/1 🐣🎉 )
normal.text: I do not care for Stardew Valley. Farming sim games like Harvest Moon have never interested me, and despite how pretty it looks, SV has always seemed like more of that. That's not to say the genre as a whole is off the table. I like Potion Permit, and I've been meaning to check Rune Factory...
